LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Militia.title: frontier militiaman
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Militia.description: [PAWN_nameDef] farmed a plot on the northern frontier and drilled with the village militia every tenth day. When the raiders came, [PAWN_pronoun] held the gate.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Scholar.title: examination scholar
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Scholar.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studied the classics for fifteen years and passed the provincial examination on the third attempt. [PAWN_pronoun] can quote a sage for every situation and calculate taxes in [PAWN_possessive] head.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Potter.title: porcelain master
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Potter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fired imperial porcelain in a town of kilns, where a single flaw meant the piece was smashed. [PAWN_pronoun] has smashed thousands.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Physician.title: needle physician
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Physician.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned the meridians and the hundred herbs from an old court physician. [PAWN_pronoun] can read an illness in a pulse.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Crossbowman.title: wall crossbowman
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Crossbowman.description: For ten years [PAWN_nameDef] stood on the great wall with a repeating crossbow, counting the dust clouds of the steppe.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Silkweaver.title: silk weaver
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Silkweaver.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended mulberry trees and silkworms and wove brocade for the court. [PAWN_possessive] fingers are quick and [PAWN_possessive] patience is endless.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Bannerman.title: banner officer
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Bannerman.description: [PAWN_nameDef] commanded a hundred men under the red banner and was promoted for holding a river crossing for three days.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Merchant.title: caravan master
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Merchant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] led camel caravans along the silk road, trading tea for horses and silk for silver. [PAWN_pronoun] speaks a little of every language on the road.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Schoolboy.title: village school pupil
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Schoolboy.description: [PAWN_nameDef] copied characters with a brush every morning in a cold village school, dreaming of the examination halls.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_RiceTerrace.title: terrace farm child
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_RiceTerrace.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on mountain rice terraces, carrying water and herding ducks through the paddies.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Kitchen.title: tea house child
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Kitchen.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a busy tea house, folding dumplings in the kitchen and listening to storytellers in the hall.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Martial.title: temple martial pupil
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BS_Martial.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was sent to a mountain temple where the monks taught [PAWN_objective] to stand in a horse stance for an hour and strike without anger.
